summary: Backend /api/pinky/auth now returns 200 with valid signed_url (text) and conversation_token (voice) — all 5 pytest cases pass. UI layout (bottom-right position, 112->88px shrink, 8px gap between panel and button, arc-text hidden when active) verified pixel-accurate. Intro animation guard works: text is identical after clicking CV prompt (no re-render/animation). CV prompt correctly stays client-side (no auth call). VOICE mode successfully fetches auth, uses conversation_token, opens LiveKit and joins room, but ElevenLabs agent immediately responds 'Server error: Unknown error' and disconnects (agent-side config issue, not widget). TEXT mode has TWO critical issues: (a) code never fetches /api/pinky/auth?mode=text (branch is voice-only in AgentPanel.jsx), directly contradicting the spec point #4 verification criteria; (b) the plain-agentId text WebSocket to wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/conversation opens then closes immediately with no frames, so NO agent-role bubble ever renders — primary success criterion fails and 'Connection error' banner shows.

integration_issues.issue: AgentPanel.jsx connect effect never calls /api/pinky/auth for sessionMode==='text' — auth fetch is gated by `if (sessionMode === 'voice')` (lines 100-123). Spec (item #4) and verification criterion explicitly require the widget to hit /api/pinky/auth?mode=text on first typed send. Verified via Playwright network capture: zero requests to /api/pinky/auth?mode=text.

Widget opens wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/conversation?agent_id=... with plain agentId (no signed URL / no conversation_signature); ElevenLabs closes the socket immediately (no frames received) and startSession rejects, triggering 'Connection error' banner. NO pinky-msg-agent bubble ever appears. Since backend already returns a valid signed_url with convai_write, the fix is to fetch /api/pinky/auth?mode=text and pass its signed_url to startSession (per spec even though it's single-turn, the first-message reply is the stated success criterion).

Voice path is wired correctly (auth 200 -> conversation_token -> LiveKit room joins, mic publishes) but ElevenLabs signals 'Server error: Unknown error' immediately after track publish and closes the room. Widget shows 'Connection error' banner. Likely ElevenLabs agent-side rejection (agent config / allowlist / voice policy) — outside widget code. Logging the raw error object would help RCA (currently console logs empty errorType/code/debugMessage).

After open: floating button box = {w:88, h:88}, arc 'Ask Pinky' SVG not visible (screenshot 02), panel box top-y (360) + height (600) = 960; button top-y = 968 -> gap = 8px exactly
IntroMessage: text before and after clicking pinky-prompt-show-me-your-cv is byte-identical; per-word animate flag `hasAnimatedOnce` prevents re-animation on ConversationProvider remount
CV prompt is client-side: sending it produces user bubble + 'Open Resume' tool bubble with NO /api/pinky/auth request

Voice flow issues GET /api/pinky/auth?mode=voice (200) then opens wss://livekit.rtc.elevenlabs.io/rtc/v1?access_token=<token>, joins room, publishes mic track — confirms conversation_token wiring end-to-end

agent.config.js exports VOICE_FIRST_MESSAGE = "Hi, I'm Pinky, Preeti's portfolio twin..."; AgentPanel.jsx lines 92-98 attach overrides.agent.firstMessage only when sessionMode==='voice' and textOnly=true only when sessionMode==='text'
action_items: AgentPanel.jsx: extend the auth-fetch branch to also run for sessionMode==='text' (fetch /api/pinky/auth?mode=text and, per spec, discard the signed_url and continue with agentId — OR use the signed_url so the first reply actually arrives). Test criteria explicitly requires (a) the endpoint be hit AND (b) an agent reply bubble to render. Using the signed_url is the simplest way to satisfy (b).

Text-mode plain-agentId WebSocket is being closed by ElevenLabs immediately. Either the agent's allowlist needs this origin whitelisted, or the widget should use the signed_url from /api/pinky/auth?mode=text (which we verified returns a valid wss:// URL with conversation_signature).

Voice-mode LiveKit connection reaches 'connected' state then agent server sends 'Server error: Unknown error' with empty errorType/code — likely agent config issue on ElevenLabs side; investigate agent voice/model config and check ElevenLabs dashboard logs for the conversation id. Enhance the error surfacing in AgentPanel error handler to include the raw provider error for future debugging.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger still declared AFTER endpoint definitions (line 154). If any request handler used `logger` at import time it would NameError; currently safe at runtime but confusing. Move logging config near the top.
server.py: sync `requests.get` inside a def (not async def) blocks the event loop under load. Switch to httpx.AsyncClient + async def get_pinky_auth.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handler.

AgentPanel.jsx: the auth-fetch code path is duplicated logic between text/voice; refactor to always fetch and branch on returned payload (signed_url vs conversation_token). This would fix the text-mode omission naturally.
AgentPanel.jsx: 'Connection error. Please try again later.' is a black-box message. Include e?.message / e?.details in dev-mode banner or console for RCA.

success_rate.frontend: UI/layout 100%; text-mode integration 0% (no agent reply); voice-mode wiring 100% but agent-server rejects

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint is fully working. Do NOT retest multi-turn per user note. Focus retest on: (1) text send triggers /api/pinky/auth?mode=text network call (Playwright request interception on that exact URL), (2) first agent bubble (data-testid='pinky-msg-agent') appears within ~10s of send. Voice server-error is an ElevenLabs agent-config issue, likely out of scope for widget code fixes; document but don't block on it. Key data-testids: pinky-floating-button, pinky-agent-panel, pinky-intro, pinky-prompt-show-me-your-cv, pinky-text-input, pinky-send-button, pinky-msg-user, pinky-msg-agent, pinky-error-banner, pinky-voice-toggle, pinky-voice-orb.
rca of the issue: AgentPanel.jsx wraps the auth fetch inside `if (sessionMode === 'voice') { ... }` (lines 100-123). The text branch never runs the fetch and directly calls startSession({agentId, overrides:{conversation:{textOnly:true}}}). ElevenLabs then rejects the unauthenticated agent WebSocket (allowlist check) and closes the socket → startSession promise rejects → catch block sets the network-error banner. Fix: move the auth-fetch outside the voice-only guard so text mode also fetches /api/pinky/auth?mode=text. Optionally pass the returned signed_url to startSession({signedUrl}) instead of {agentId} for text — this will get the first-message reply through even with the single-turn signed-URL limitation the team already acknowledged.
